evidence.summary: Reviewed twelve sentence-specific CET6 judgements across modifiers, adverbials, noun-content clauses and parenthetical comments. Each now includes a complete practice sentence and a plausible claim; seven true and five false follow the actual interpretations, with no required answer-balancing rule. Explanations preserve dependency, negation, evidence source and scope and remove absolute position-only grammar heuristics. No audio or ownership changes; synthetic provenance retained. This is candidate text review, not official exam authenticity or full-track authorization.
